summary: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors.
takeaways: However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors.
SciGame contains a Historical collection of canonical laws and a live Temporal collection curated from papers published after model knowledge cutoffs.
It evaluates agents in candidate-guided Identification and open-ended Discovery settings.
